front: What did the 1924 Immigration Act do?
back: Set quotas of 2 per cent of each nationality in 1890, cutting southern and eastern Europeans and almost ending Asian immigration.

front: When were Sacco and Vanzetti executed?
back: August 1927, after a trial many thought unfair.

front: Why did the Klan decline after 1925?
back: A leader in Indiana was convicted of murder, exposing its hypocrisy, and membership collapsed.

front: Why was the Sacco and Vanzetti case controversial?
back: The evidence was disputed and prejudice against them as Italian anarchists seemed to affect the trial.

front: Why did the Red Scare happen?
back: The Russian Revolution, strikes and anarchist bombings in 1919 made many fear revolution.
